note: Inventory re-derived 2026-09-23 from the handoff vendored that day. The design gained the login-service install (J24), the unsigned-build line (J10), the tailnet reach card (J25, drawn in TailnetReach and inventoried in tailnet-reach-v2.json), SSH hosts (J41), and the account-free lines replaced (I59). Repository browsing moved into the imported RemoteBrowser (J40, remote-browser-v2.json). Statuses record current implementation evidence and platform blockers; layout, visual state and interaction fidelity remain human-read checks.
